_doc: Single source of frozen paths for scripts/frozen_guard.py (commit + worktree checks), src/depthlaw/frozen_rt.py (runtime write guard) and scripts/log_run.py (before/after check). Added 2026-11-25 after integrity incident INC-2026-11-25-required-macros. This file is itself frozen. The PROTECTED list in .claude/hooks/protect_frozen.py is a separate, older layer installed by the human.

override._doc: A staged change to a frozen path passes only if DEPTHLAW_FROZEN_OVERRIDE=1 and the staged ledger has a NOTE whose tag starts with the prefix and whose --file hashes equal the staged content of every changed frozen path. The human sets the env var; the hook patch staged in reports/pending_frozen_changes/guard_2026-11-25/ blocks agent commands that set it.
